content: Python docs: os.replace atomic if successful (POSIX requirement); docs give no Windows atomicity guarantee; Windows uses MoveFileEx and fails with PermissionError if the target is held open without delete sharing (e.g. Excel). os.kill on Windows with any sig other than CTRL_C_EVENT/CTRL_BREAK_EVENT calls TerminateProcess (kills the process) so os.kill(pid,0) is not a liveness probe on Windows.
